parsed.post: Discarding the LR 0.06 run (0.996780 vs 0.987754). It appears the learning rate was too high for this depth/batch configuration to converge effectively in 5 minutes. Reverting to 2b52ef9. Next: testing a more conservative MATRIX_LR = 0.055 to see if a smaller step helps.
parsed.description: Testing a slightly higher learning rate (0.055) than the current best (0.05) to see if it improves convergence without the instability seen at 0.06.
